items.headline: $2 million single-family home permitted on Fleming Avenue
items.summary: A new single-family residence at 1370 Fleming Avenue received a building permit with a declared construction value of about $1.99 million, well above the cost of the other new homes permitted this week.

items.headline: Five new single-family homes permitted on Britton Ave, Camino Ramon
items.summary: Permits were issued for five new single-family homes on adjoining lots at 1300, 1304, and 1308 Britton Avenue and 1205 and 1225 Camino Ramon, with attached ADUs also permitted at three of those addresses. The matching lot numbers and same-day issuance indicate a small subdivision being built out together.

items.headline: Council to weigh higher affordable housing fees on new developments
items.summary: A study session is scheduled to consider raising inclusionary housing requirements and updating below-market-rate in-lieu fees developers pay for new rental and ownership housing projects.

items.headline: Eight new homes proposed to replace one house on Wolfe Road
items.summary: A developer plans to demolish a single-family home at 781 S Wolfe Rd and build eight two-story houses on the 0.57-acre lot, subdividing it into eight separate parcels plus a common area.
